runs.name: LZW round trip on compress.c
runs.cmd: mkdir -p $BODY/build && ./compress -c compress.c > $BODY/build/c.Z && ./compress -dc $BODY/build/c.Z | cmp - compress.c && echo ROUNDTRIP_OK $(stat -c %s compress.c) '->' $(stat -c %s $BODY/build/c.Z)

tests.name: a corrupted .Z is refused, not silently decoded
tests.cmd: cp $BODY/build/c.Z $BODY/build/bad.Z && printf '\xff\xff\xff\xff' | dd of=$BODY/build/bad.Z bs=1 seek=100 conv=notrunc 2>/dev/null && ./compress -dc $BODY/build/bad.Z > /dev/null 2>&1; test $? -ne 0 && echo CORRUPTION_DETECTED
